title: After Totalitarianism: Museum, Memory and the Belarusian Perspective
description: A public international conference at the Free Belarus Museum, 8–9 October 2026. Andrei Arkhipenka took part in one of its panels with a presentation on Taiwan’s memory culture.
body:
On 8–9 October 2026, Warsaw hosted the international conference “After Totalitarianism: Museum, Memory and the Belarusian Perspective”, organised by the Free Belarus Museum.

Andrei Arkhipenka, founder of Belarus–Taiwan & East Asia Platform and a researcher, took part in one of the panels at this public conference. His presentation focused on Taiwan’s memory culture.
